d:
The Lakers defeated the Bucks, 123-112 tonight in Milwaukee. Luka Dončić contributed a team-high 32 points to go with 5 rebounds 5 assists and 5 three pointers, with Sandro Mamukelashvili of the Lakers adding an additional 23 points (9-15 FG, 5-8 3P) in the game. Tyler Herro finished with a team-high 27 points along with 7 assists for the Bucks in the losing effort. The Lakers improve their record to 11-2 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-11 for the season.
